brief:
Political analyst Muhammad Mustafa Shahin warned that Israeli Defense Minister Yisrael Katz's threats to displace one million Palestinians from Gaza southward expose a broader Israeli scheme to restructure the territory's demographic and geographic reality, according to Shehab Wire. Shahin said the threats aim to convert temporary displacement into permanent deportation through territorial expansion.

The analyst characterized the stated intention as part of a larger Israeli effort to fundamentally reshape Gaza's population and geography, transforming what has been framed as temporary evacuation into a permanent demographic shift.

title: Shahin warns Katz threats reveal Israeli plan to reshape Gaza demographics
